== Passive Ability: Twisted Love ==
Summon the last dead enemy damaged by '''{{PAGENAME}}''' with '''25%''' of their original health every '''5 attacks'''. (Global Limit of 10 summons at once).

This passive is also called '''Resurrection Dance''', which unlocks at '''Upgrade 1'''.
== Selling ==
